children: Wynn Resorts priced $900 million of 6.875% Senior Notes due 2035 in a private offering to fund redemption of 2027 notes.
Issuers priced $900M aggregate principal of 6.875% Senior Notes due 2035 in a private offering.
Offering expected to close on or about September 22, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
Net proceeds plus cash on hand will be contributed or lent to Wynn Las Vegas to redeem 5.250% Senior Notes due 2027.
Notes offered to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S; not registered under the Securities Act.
Transaction may affect leverage and debt service profile; forward-looking statements note risks including economic and interest rate factors.
